title: Trillanes 'peddling same exhausted lies,' says camp of VP Duterte
summary: Former Senator Antonio Trillanes IV has been "peddling the same exhausted lies" against the Duterte family since 2016, the camp of Vice President Sara Duterte said on Saturday.
